Bachelor’s degree OR equivalent healthcare/hospital experience.
Prior experience using the Samaritan volunteer management software.
Recruit, schedule, and onboard hospital volunteers, ensuring all required training, health clearances, and background checks are completed.
Maintain accurate volunteer records and attendance in the volunteer data management system while providing general administrative support to hospital departments.
Guide volunteers on hospital policies, patient privacy, safety protocols, and appropriate interaction standards while escalating any patient care or safety concerns to supervisors.
Assist with approved community outreach activities and volunteer appreciation events, delivering engaging presentations to volunteers and staff.
Background in coordinating volunteer programs, community outreach, or program events in a healthcare or non-profit setting.
Excellent customer service, interpersonal, and public speaking skills.
Working knowledge of hospital compliance standards, including patient privacy, infection prevention, and safety protocols.
Ability to work independently, manage time efficiently, and maintain professional boundaries with patients, visitors, and staff.
Demonstrated ability to build relationships with community partners and collaborate across multi-disciplinary healthcare teams.
Strong organizational skills and basic proficiency with administrative data entry and recordkeeping.
